try:
		"""
		Return ProductCode rows (ID, ProductCode) that have at least one StandardRate
		for the provided NodeID. Uses productcodeTable.selectCustom with an EXISTS subquery.
	
		Inputs:
			value["db"] (str): Database connection name (MSSQL).
			value["nodeID"] (int): Node identifier to filter standardrate rows.
	
		Returns:
			PyDataSet: Columns ['ID', 'ProductCode'] (distinct by table uniqueness).
		"""
		# Initialization of variables
		db = value["db"]
		nodeID = int(value["nodeID"])
	
		# Logic
		table = mes_core.model.productcodeTable(dbConnection=db)
		columns = ['ID', 'ProductCode']
		where_clause = """
			EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM standardrate sr
				WHERE sr.ProductCodeID = productcode.ID
				  AND sr.NodeID = ?
			)
		"""
		where_args = [nodeID]
	
		ds = table.selectCustom(columns=columns, where_clause=where_clause, where_args=where_args)
	
		# Optional: order by ProductCode ASC (client-side)
		import system
		ds_sorted = system.dataset.sort(ds, 'ProductCode', True)
	
		# Return
		return ds_sorted
	
	except:
		# Return (empty dataset on failure)
		import system
		return system.dataset.toDataSet(['ID', 'ProductCode'], [])

config.script:
import re
	import system
	import mes_core
	logger = system.util.getLogger("CreateEditNode")
	func = getattr(self.view.params, "function", None)
	if func not in ("Crear", "Editar"):
		return 0

	db = self.view.custom.dbConnection
	table = mes_core.model.nodeTable(db)

	# Entradas UI
	name = (self.view.custom.inName or u"").strip()
	topic = (self.view.custom.inTopic or u"").strip()
	typ = (self.view.custom.inType or u"").strip().upper()
	parentId = self.view.custom.inParentID
	displayname = name
	selectable = self.view.custom.inDisable
	node_id = self.view.params.selection.selID

	# Requeridos básicos
	if not name:
		self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Ingrese un Nombre"
		return 0
	if not topic:
		self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Ingrese un Topic"
		return 0

	# Validación de tipo
	allowed = {"ENTERPRISE", "SITE", "AREA", "LINE", "EQUIPMENT"}
	if typ not in allowed:
		self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Tipo inválido. Use: ENTERPRISE, SITE, AREA, LINE o EQUIPMENT."
		return 0

	# Formato de Topic por tipo
	depth_by_type = {"ENTERPRISE": 1, "SITE": 2, "AREA": 3, "LINE": 4, "EQUIPMENT": 5}
	placeholders = ["Enterprise", "Site", "Area", "Line", "Equipment"]
	expected_depth = depth_by_type[typ]
	expected_example = "/".join(placeholders[:expected_depth])

	parts = topic.split("/")
	if len(parts) != expected_depth:
		self.view.custom.textLabel = (
			u"Formato de Ruta inválido para {}. Debe tener {} segmento(s): {}"
			.format(typ, expected_depth, expected_example)
		)
		return 0

	alnum_space = re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z0-9 ]+$')
	for i, seg in enumerate(parts, 1):
		seg = seg.strip()
		if not seg:
			self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Segmento {} de la Ruta está vacío. Ejemplo: {}".format(i, expected_example)
			return 0
		if not alnum_space.match(seg):
			self.view.custom.textLabel = (
				u"Segmento {} inválido: '{}'. Use solo letras/números ASCII y espacios; "
				u"sin tildes, 'ñ' ni símbolos. Ejemplo: {}".format(i, seg, expected_example)
			)
			return 0

	# Último segmento debe coincidir con Name (case-insensitive)
	if parts[-1].strip().upper() != name.strip().upper():
		self.view.custom.textLabel = (
			u"El último segmento de la Ruta ('{}') debe coincidir con el Nombre ('{}')."
			.format(parts[-1].strip(), name)
		)
		return 0

	# Unicidad de Topic (global) usando validateColumn
	topic_exists, topic_ids = table.validateColumn({'Topic': topic})
	if func == "Crear":
		if topic_exists:
			self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Ya existe una Ruta igual (IDs: {}).".format(", ".join(map(str, topic_ids)))
			return 0
	else:  # Editar: permitir si es el mismo registro
		if topic_exists:
			ids_ajenos = [i for i in topic_ids if i != node_id]
			if len(ids_ajenos) > 0:
				self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Ya existe una Ruta igual en otro registro (IDs: {}).".format(", ".join(map(str, ids_ajenos)))
				return 0

	# ===== Ramas por tipo (ARREGLADO: if/elif) =====
	if typ == "ENTERPRISE":
		# Parent permitido (y forzado) a NULL
		parentId = None

		# Name único global (excluye self si edita)
		if func == "Crear":
			dupe_name = table.select(where_clause="Name = ?", where_args=[name], columns=["ID"])
		else:
			dupe_name = table.select(where_clause="Name = ? AND ID <> ?", where_args=[name, node_id], columns=["ID"])
		if dupe_name and dupe_name.getRowCount() > 0:
			ids = [dupe_name.getValueAt(r, "ID") for r in range(dupe_name.getRowCount())]
			self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Ya existe un Nombre de ENTERPRISE igual (IDs: {}).".format(", ".join(map(str, ids)))
			return 0

		# Topic debe ser exactamente Name
		if topic != name:
			self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Para ENTERPRISE, la Ruta debe ser exactamente '{}'.".format(name)
			return 0

	elif typ in ("SITE", "AREA", "LINE", "EQUIPMENT"):
		# Parent requerido
		if parentId is None:
			self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Seleccione un ID Padre para el tipo {}.".format(typ)
			return 0

		# Unicidad (ParentNodeID, Name) (excluye self si edita)
		if func == "Crear":
			dupe_name = table.select(
				where_clause="ParentNodeID = ? AND Name = ?",
				where_args=[parentId, name],
				columns=["ID"]
			)
		else:
			dupe_name = table.select(
				where_clause="ParentNodeID = ? AND Name = ? AND ID <> ?",
				where_args=[parentId, name, node_id],
				columns=["ID"]
			)
		if dupe_name and dupe_name.getRowCount() > 0:
			ids = [dupe_name.getValueAt(r, "ID") for r in range(dupe_name.getRowCount())]
			self.view.custom.textLabel = u"Ya existe un Nombre igual bajo el mismo ID Padre (IDs: {}).".format(", ".join(map(str, ids)))
			return 0

		# Consistencia con el Parent: Topic esperado
		parent_ds = table.select(where_clause="ID = ?", where_args=[parentId], columns=["Topic"])
		if not parent_ds or parent_ds.getRowCount() == 0:
			self.view.custom.textLabel = u"ID Padre no encontrado."
			return 0
		parent_topic = parent_ds.getValueAt(0, "Topic")
		expected_topic = parent_topic + "/" + name
		if topic != expected_topic:
			self.view.custom.textLabel = (
				u"Ruta inconsistente con el ID Padre. Esperado: '{}'. Recibido: '{}'."
				.format(expected_topic, topic)
			)
			return 0
	# ================================================

	# Operación
	if func == "Crear":
		table.insert(
			selectable=selectable,
			type=typ,
			displayname=displayname,
			parentnodeid=parentId,
			name=name,
			topic=topic
		)
		try:
			system.perspective.closePopup("createeditnode")
		except:
			pass
		if alerts:
			try:
				alerts.actionSuccess(title='Nodo creado', message=u'Nodo \"{}\" creado correctamente'.format(topic))
			except Exception as e:
				logger.warn("alerts.actionSuccess error: {}".format(e))
	else:  # Editar
		if node_id is None:
			self.view.custom.textLabel = u"No se encontró el ID del nodo a editar."
			return 0

		set_values = {
			'Selectable': selectable,
			'Type': typ,
			'DisplayName': displayname,
			'ParentNodeID': parentId,
			'Name': name,
			'Topic': topic
		}
		# Evita escribir None accidentales salvo ParentNodeID/Selectable
		set_values = dict((k, v) for k, v in set_values.items() if v is not None or k in ('ParentNodeID', 'Selectable'))

		table.updateID(node_id, set_values)
		try:
			system.perspective.closePopup("createeditnode")
		except Exception as e:
			logger.warn("closePopup error: {}".format(e))
		if alerts:
			try:
				alerts.actionSuccess(title='Nodo actualizado', message=u'Nodo ID {} actualizado correctamente'.format(node_id))
			except:
				pass

	# Refresh (verifica que el message handler exista con ese nombre)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTableNode", payload={})
	return 1
